goal: Develop Iterfox's return-to-work experience so the operator can understand actual multi-mission progress without prompting repeatedly. Read docs/continuous-project-trial.md for the fixed scope and interfaces. The current outcome is the implementation target; future outcomes are handed to new missions automatically. Own ordinary reversible decisions. Report real blockers only. Keep original evidence, history, acceptance and permissions intact. This is an approved local implementation; no publication, deployment, push or merge. Existing UI and eleven Chrome workflows must remain functional. Do not edit protected tests or dependency files. Request host verification rather than running browser suites inside the agent sandbox. Technical completion remains subject to operator product review.
productAcceptance: Not established by technical checkpoints; operator product review is required.

usage.accounting: Reported turns and tokens are summed once per unique mission linked to an approved outcome. Unrelated missions are excluded. Unreported or interrupted-turn token usage and monetary cost are unavailable. The authorization window includes pauses and is never reset by a mission or resume. Missing ledgers make totals partial and remaining turn/token budgets unavailable.
